response.sql: SELECT g.event_status, g.avg_left AS average_left_over, g.avg_left - o.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall FROM (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_left FROM budget WHERE event_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_status) g CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS overall_avg FROM budget) o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
